{{Top|leg}}
The '''rapid-pulse energy module''' was a weapon component used in [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn's]] [[Model MSD-32 Disruptor Pistol]]. It was designed to circumvent the inherent power problems in [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptors]] such as the low ammunition count and slow fire rate. The rapid-pulse energy module generated a series of energy pulses that created a powerful disruptor bolt and in turn extended the weapon's [[Blaster power pack/Legends|power pack]] ammunition from five to ten shots and reduced the recharge time between shots from five [[Standard second|seconds]] to three.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
